user_saw: A Windows npm update failed when another process briefly locked the installed package directory during backup.
summary: The fix adds bounded retries and per-attempt diagnostics for transient Windows errors while renaming the live package directory to its backup location.
reasoning: I checked #136329 and its parent and found that the commit replaced `movePathWithCopyFallback` with a single `await fs.rename(targetSwapRoot, backupRoot)` for npm backups. The backup operation already existed, but the previous helper was supplied by an external dependency and the available tests only establish its cross-device fallback, so I could not verify whether transient Windows locks already caused the same failure.
